title: Faster repurchase flow
demand: Se o fluxo for mais rápido ele pode converter mais que o App, e o custo de interação é menor. Objetivo: agilizar a compra e reduzir custo. Também queremos entender se ajuda na recorrência ou mexe no AOV.
context: App, compared with another channel (comparison unclear)

fragments.text: converter mais que o App, reduzir custo

B.why: Outcomes are named but there is no baseline or target; not lower because E-002 names them.

U.why: No user or situation stated; not 0 because E-001 shows recurrent repurchase exists.

S.why: Articulated as a concept but undefined (E-003); no evidence links speed to conversion.

hypotheses.statement: if it is faster, it converts more than the App
it helps recurrence or changes AOV

evidence.claim: Recurrent repurchase exists enough to investigate a repurchase journey.
evidence.population: recurrent customers of the analyzed flow
evidence.limitations: does not show the current flow is slow, nor that speed increases conversion

evidence.claim: Reducing time to order and interaction cost are desired outcomes.
evidence.limitations: a desired outcome is not causality

evidence.claim: No product or flow rule was specified at the start.
